shellCommands.command: ls -la /workspace && echo "---PYTHON---" && python3 --version 2>&1 && echo "---PIP FLASK---" && python3 -c "import flask; print('flask', flask.__version__)" 2>&1 && echo "---NODE---" && node --version 2>&1
node --version && echo "---" && ls /workspace/node_modules | head -50 && echo "---EXPRESS?---" && ls /workspace/node_modules | grep -i -E "express|fastify|hapi" 2>&1
cd /workspace && node app.js & echo $! > /tmp/app.pid && sleep 1 && echo "started"

cd /workspace
echo "=== 1. Home (empty) ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -E "Nothing in progress|No finished books" | head -2

echo "=== 2. Add a book (POST /books) ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "status=%{http_code} redirect=%{redirect_url}\n" -X POST http://localhost:3000/books --data-urlencode "title=The Pragmatic Programmer" --data-urlencode "author=Hunt & Thomas" --data-urlencode "notes=Great so far.

Ch1: solid advice."

echo "=== 3. Home now shows it under Currently reading ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -E "Pragmatic Programmer|Hunt" | head -2

echo "=== 4. books.json persisted ==="
node -e "const b=require('/workspace/books.json').books; console.log('count=',b.length,'status=',b[0].status,'id=',b[0].id.slice(0,8),'author=',b[0].author)"

echo "=== 5. Fetch book detail page ==="
ID=$(node -e "console.log(require('/workspace/books.json').books[0].id)")
curl -s "http://localhost:3000/books/$ID" | grep -E "Shareable link|localhost:3000/books|Mark as finished|Great so far" | head -4

echo "=== 6. Mark finished ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "status=%{http_code} redirect=%{redirect_url}\n" -X POST "http://localhost:3000/books/$ID/finish"
node -e "const b=require('/workspace/books.json').books[0]; console.log('status=',b.status,'finishedAt=',b.finishedAt)"

echo "=== 7. Home now shows Finished section ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -A1 "Finished" | grep -E "Pragmatic" | head -1

echo "=== 8. Edit notes (POST edit) ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "status=%{http_code} redirect=%{redirect_url}\n" -X POST "http://localhost:3000/books/$ID/edit" --data-urlencode "title=The Pragmatic Programmer" --data-urlencode "author=Hunt & Thomas" --data-urlencode "notes=Updated notes here"
node -e "console.log('notes=',require('/workspace/books.json').books[0].notes)"

echo "=== 9. XSS attempt in a new book (should be escaped) ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -X POST http://localhost:3000/books --data-urlencode "title=<script>alert(1)</script>" --data-urlencode "author=x"
ID2=$(node -e "const b=require('/workspace/books.json').books; console.log(b.find(x=>x.author==='x').id)")
curl -s "http://localhost:3000/books/$ID2" | grep -c "<script>alert" && echo "(0 = escaped/safe)"

echo "=== 10. 404 for unknown book ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "status=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/books/does-not-exist

cd /workspace echo "=== Finished section on home ===" curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -A3 '

Finished

' echo "=== XSS escaped form in detail (should show <script>) ===" ID2=$(node -e "const b=require('/workspace/books.json').books; console.log(b.find(x=>x.author==='x').id)") curl -s "http://localhost:3000/books/$ID2" | grep -o "<script>alert(1)</script>" | head -1 echo "=== cleanup: stop server & remove test data ===" kill "$(cat /tmp/app.pid)" 2>/dev/null; rm -f /workspace/books.json /workspace/books.json.tmp; echo done
